function.description: Find open appointment times. Call this whenever the caller asks about availability, mentions a day or time they'd like, or after they choose a service. NEVER guess or state a time this tool did not return. If the caller says something vague like 'sometime next week', pick the first date of that range and call this — you can call it again for other days.
function.name: checkAvailability

preferredDate.description: Local date in YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later. Never guess a year the caller did not say.

providerPreference.description: Provider name if the caller asked for someone specific. Omit if they did not.

serviceCode.description: Service code, e.g. massage_60. Call getServicesAndPricing first to get it.

timePreference.description: Rough time of day the caller asked for. Use 'any' if they did not say.
